	int l[N], tot, cur[N], d[N], u, v, s, t, src, sink;

	struct Edge {
		int v, x, cap;
	} E[111111];

	void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
		E[tot] = (Edge) {v, l[u], cap};
		l[u] = tot ++;
		E[tot] = (Edge) {u, l[v], 0};
		l[v] = tot ++;
	}

	void init() {
		memset(l, -1, sizeof l);
		tot = 0;
	}

	bool bfs() {
		memset(d, -1, sizeof d);
		memcpy(cur, l, sizeof l);
		d[src] = 0;
		queue<int> Q;
		Q.push(src);
		while(!Q.empty()) {
			u = Q.front();
			Q.pop();
			for(int i = l[u]; ~i; i = E[i].x) {
				v = E[i].v;
				if(d[v] == - 1 && E[i].cap) {
					d[v] = d[u] + 1;
					Q.push(v);
				}
			}
		}
		return d[sink] != -1;
	}

	int dfs(int u, int in) {
		if(u == sink)	return in;
		int flow = 0, f;
		for(int &i = cur[u]; ~i; i = E[i].x) {
			v = E[i].v;
			if(d[v] == d[u] + 1 && E[i].cap) {
				if(f=dfs(v, min(in-flow, E[i].cap))) {
					flow += f;
					E[i].cap -= f;
					E[i^1].cap += f;
					if(flow == in)	break;
				}
			}
		}
		if(flow < in)	d[u] = -1;
		return flow;
	}

	const int inf = 1e9;
	int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
		src = _src, sink = _sink;
		int flow = 0;
		while(bfs())
			flow += dfs(src, inf);
		return flow;
	}
